answer: That binds the text to one identity's challenge, so copying between 125 aliases produces 125 mismatches and pays the authoring cost with no payout. Because the cipher derivation is checked against the thread nonce, the forge audit keeps the accepted values and a reused text fails on the first character. An answer must include the first 10 hex characters of the seed it was derived under, and a wrong or missing derivation is rejected at intake. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
